stories.headline: OpenAI launches Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory, AI agents that pentest and patch code

key_facts.fact: At its Cyber at the Frontier event on Nov. 12, OpenAI announced two Daybreak security products: Red Team for penetration testing and Defense Factory for finding and fixing vulnerabilities.
key_facts.excerpt: The products, Daybreak Red Team and Daybreak Defense Factory, were announced at the company's Cyber at the Frontier event on November 12.

key_facts.fact: Daybreak Red Team, in early access, uses fleets of agents with source code and app context to test web applications and validate findings from scanners, bug bounties and disclosure reports.
key_facts.excerpt: Red Team, which is available in early access, uses OpenAI models to test companies' web applications for vulnerabilities... with a fleet of agents using source code and app context to investigate and test attack paths.

key_facts.fact: Defense Factory agents, built on GPT-6 Cyber, scan codebases and prepare patches; engineers review fixes before merge and nothing is deployed automatically.
key_facts.excerpt: Agents trace vulnerabilities through your code and develop patches. Engineers review and test proposed patches before merge... However, patches are not deployed automatically.

key_facts.fact: Greg Brockman said companies 'will be secure only to the extent of the frontier model that they use to defend themselves.'
key_facts.excerpt: "We're now at a point where companies will be secure only to the extent of the frontier model that they use to defend themselves and how well they utilize that," OpenAI President Greg Brockman said

key_facts.fact: OpenAI said GPT-6 Cyber scores 52% on the ExploitGym benchmark vs about 38% for Anthropic's Mythos 5.2, and that an upcoming cyber model nearly doubles Mythos 5.2's score.
key_facts.excerpt: able to achieve a much higher performance on this benchmark at 52%. For comparison, Anthropics Mythos 52... scores at about 38%... It demonstrates a significant increase, nearly double the score of Mythos 52.

key_facts.fact: Same day, nonprofits including Public Citizen sued in San Francisco Superior Court to stop OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceX's AI businesses from building models more capable than their current best.
key_facts.excerpt: a coalition of nonprofits filed a lawsuit in San Francisco Superior Court asking a judge to stop OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, and SpaceX's AI businesses from developing or deploying AI systems more capable than their most advanced existing models.

stories.headline: Anthropic's automated red-teamer Anvil beats human experts at jailbreaking Claude's safeguards

key_facts.fact: On Nov. 12 Anthropic detailed Anvil, an automated red-teaming system that outperforms human red-teamers against its bioweapons, cybersecurity and distillation safeguards.
key_facts.excerpt: we built Anvil, an automated red-teaming system, which outperforms human red-teamers against our bioweapons, cybersecurity, and distillation safeguards.

key_facts.fact: In biology, Anvil found stronger jailbreaks than all human red-teamers in Anthropic's bug bounty combined, in 24-48 hours instead of weeks to months.
key_facts.excerpt: Anvil finds stronger jailbreaks than all human red-teamers in our bug bounty program combined... finds these jailbreaks in 24–48 hours rather than weeks to months.

key_facts.fact: On cyber tasks, Anvil got the safeguarded model to write working exploits for historical Chrome and Firefox JavaScript-engine bugs, breaking each task in 0.4-4.4 hours where contracted experts took up to 177 hours.
key_facts.excerpt: Anvil gets our safeguarded model to write full working exploits of known historical vulnerabilities in the JavaScript engines of Chrome and Firefox... in 0.4–4.4 hours each, where the experts took up to 177 wall-clock hours

key_facts.fact: Against anti-distillation classifiers, Anvil leaked hidden reasoning after 435 requests versus 102,200 for expert red-teamers; training on Anvil cut real-world extraction success on Fable 5.1 from 33.8% to 0%.
key_facts.excerpt: Anvil reached its first substantial reasoning leak after 435 requests (1.2 hours), compared to the 102,200 requests (27.9 hours)... the success rate of reasoning extraction attempts we observed in real traffic fell from 33.8% to 0%.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic warns Anvil relies on internal Claude versions with safeguards disabled, and that attackers could soon build similar systems on weaker-safeguarded models.
key_facts.excerpt: It relies on frontier internal versions of Claude with safeguards disabled... suggesting that attackers could soon build similar systems on models with weaker safeguards.

key_facts.fact: Three House committee chairs separately told Huang and Nvidia General Counsel Tim Teter to appear for closed-door interviews on December 1 and 2 or face subpoenas.

stories.headline: After Dublin meeting, US says Europeans will join next Ukraine talks; largest POW swap agreed

key_facts.fact: After meeting Putin in the Kremlin on Nov. 12, US envoy Steve Witkoff said Putin agreed to let European representatives join the next round of Ukraine peace talks.
key_facts.excerpt: President Vladimir Putin agreed on Thursday to let European representatives join the next round of Ukraine peace talks, a US envoy said... "The Europeans will join at the next meeting..." Witkoff told Russian state TV after meeting Putin in the Kremlin.

key_facts.fact: Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov played down the prospect, saying Europeans first need to choose between 'peace' or 'war', and Moscow asked Europe to stop military aid to Ukraine as a condition.
key_facts.excerpt: Putin's aide, Yuri Ushakov, cautioned against the prospect of having Russians and Europeans at the same table, saying that, first, Europeans need to decide between "peace" or "war"... it has asked Europe to cease military aid to Ukraine as a condition.

key_facts.fact: Putin rejected 'grey' demilitarised zones, saying the only demarcation line is the state border, and ruled out foreign peacekeeping troops in Ukraine.
key_facts.excerpt: The Russian leader rejected talk of a possible territorial settlement involving "grey" - or demilitarised - zones... ruled out agreeing to foreign peacekeeping troops in Ukraine - a deployment that he said would be a "continuation of war".

key_facts.fact: Witkoff and Kushner then met Zelensky for almost an hour at Baldonnel Aerodrome outside Dublin on Thursday evening; Kushner said the prisoner-of-war exchange was finalised and 'we cannot conclude this deal without the Europeans being at the table'.
key_facts.excerpt: They were involved in discussions which lasted almost an hour at Baldonnel Aerodrome, on the outskirts of Dublin... "We were able to finalise on the prisoner of war exchange... We cannot conclude this deal without the Europeans being at the table"

key_facts.fact: Zelensky said the outcomes were the largest prisoner exchange since the start of the war, European participation in negotiations on an equal footing, and preparations for further multilateral meetings.
key_facts.excerpt: preparations for the largest prisoner exchange since the start of the war, greater European involvement in negotiations on an equal footing, and plans for further multilateral meetings

key_facts.fact: No compromise on a settlement emerged; the next round of talks could take place in the UAE or Switzerland.
key_facts.excerpt: The next peace talks could take place in the UAE or Switzerland. As for a peaceful settlement, there are still no compromises on this issue.

stories.headline: US 10-year yield tops 5.1% as Fed officials signal more hikes; December increase fully priced

key_facts.fact: When the bond market reopened Thursday after Veterans Day, the 2-year Treasury yield rose to 4.87% and the 10-year topped 5.11%, following a hotter-than-expected October CPI report.
key_facts.excerpt: Yields climbed further when the bond market reopened Thursday, sending the 2-year note to 4.87% and the 10-year above 5.11%. Higher bond yields come after a hotter-than-expected October consumer inflation report

key_facts.excerpt: fed funds futures, which were last pricing in three quarter point raises by March... That would put the target rate in a range between 4.50% and 4.75%, up from 3.75% and 4.00% currently.

key_facts.fact: Markets fully priced a December hike of at least 25 basis points, with a 15% chance of 50 bp; San Francisco Fed's Mary Daly said further hikes will likely be needed while Cleveland's Beth Hammack opposed shifting to more aggressive moves.

stories.headline: DOJ moves to seize $1.2B stolen by North Korea from Binance; dismantles deepfake 'FaceStealer' scheme

key_facts.fact: The Justice Department said on Nov. 12 it obtained court authorization to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion in crypto stolen from Binance.
key_facts.excerpt: the court-authorized seizure and restraint of more than $1.2 billion worth of cryptocurrency recently stolen from Binance, a virtual currency exchange.

key_facts.fact: North Korean military hackers the FBI calls 'TraderTraitor' stole more than $6 billion from Binance around Oct. 29; US government and private-sector efforts have frozen more than $2.7 billion, of which the $1.2 billion is part.
key_facts.excerpt: on or about Oct. 29, members of the North Korean military, referred to by the FBI as "TraderTraitor" stole more than $6 billion... Collective U.S. government and private sector efforts so far have resulted in the freeze of more than $2.7 billion, with the Department having already obtained court-authorization to seize or restrain in excess of $1.2 billion of that amount.

key_facts.fact: The freezes were carried out with stablecoin issuers Tether and Circle in the immediate aftermath of the break-in.
key_facts.excerpt: The department got court authorization to seize or restrain $1.2 billion of the $2.7 billion of funds frozen by Tether and Circle Internet Group Inc. in the immediate aftermath of the Oct. 29 break-in.

key_facts.fact: The DOJ also seized cloud infrastructure used in 'FaceStealer', a North Korean scheme using fake video calls and deepfakes that stole more than $400 million over 18 months; the FBI seized more than 900 webcam videos of victims.
key_facts.excerpt: the disruption of a North Korean hacking campaign known as FaceStealer, which used deepfake videos and fraudulent online meetings to steal more than $400 million in cryptocurrency over the past 18 months. The FBI seized cloud-based infrastructure used in the campaign and more than 900 webcam videos of victims.

key_facts.fact: FaceStealer hackers increasingly targeted open-source software developers and maintainers, apparently to enable supply-chain attacks.
key_facts.excerpt: The hackers also increasingly targeted developers and maintainers of open-source software in apparent attempts to enable broader software supply-chain attacks

key_facts.fact: Binance said the same day it had completed coverage of assets affected by the hack; it had previously put losses at about $6.3 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Binance previously put its losses at about $6.3 billion... Earlier Thursday, Binance said it has completed coverage of assets impacted in the hack and published a new proof of reserves snapshot.

stories.headline: Kalshi in talks to raise at $65B weeks after $40B round; ends Donald Trump Jr.'s advisory role

key_facts.fact: Prediction market Kalshi is in talks to raise money at a $65 billion valuation, weeks after closing a round at $40 billion, Bloomberg reported on Nov. 12.
key_facts.excerpt: Weeks after closing a funding round at a $40 billion valuation, Kalshi is now in talks to raise more money from investors valuing the prediction market at $65 billion

key_facts.fact: The late-October round had been expected to be Kalshi's last before an IPO.
key_facts.excerpt: The fundraising round announced in late October was expected to be the last one before the company's anticipated initial public offering, but the company decided to raise money again in the private markets

key_facts.fact: Kalshi's monthly notional volume rose from $40 billion in August to nearly $100 billion in October, with annual run-rate revenue above $5 billion and roughly 90% gross margins.
key_facts.excerpt: monthly notional trading volume more than doubling from $40 billion in August to nearly $100 billion in October... generating roughly 90% gross margins and surpassing $5 billion in annual run-rate revenue.

key_facts.fact: The same day, Kalshi said Donald Trump Jr. would no longer serve as an adviser, citing his firm 1789 Capital's roughly $300 million added investment in rival Polymarket in August.
key_facts.excerpt: Kalshi... said on Thursday that Donald Trump Jr., the president's eldest son, would no longer serve as an adviser... after 1789, in August, added about $300 million to its investments in Polymarket

key_facts.fact: Trump Jr. still advises Polymarket, and his exit comes as Democrats, who won both chambers of Congress, are expected to crack down on prediction markets.
key_facts.excerpt: Trump Jr.'s departure comes after Democrats secured a majority across the House and the Senate, with the party expected to crack down on the prediction market industry. While Trump Jr. has exited Kalshi, he still serves as an advisor to Polymarket.

stories.headline: SpaceX and Tesla merger talks advance; record deal could be announced as soon as December

key_facts.fact: SpaceX and Tesla are progressing in merger negotiations and could announce what would be the biggest-ever deal as soon as December, Bloomberg reported on Nov. 12; an announcement could also slip into early 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Elon Musk's two largest companies could announce what would be the biggest-ever deal as soon as in December... The companies have also discussed a scenario in which an announcement slips into early 2027

key_facts.fact: Boards and advisers are working through terms and governance; a key obstacle is ring-fencing Tesla's China operations from SpaceX's US government and defense contracts.
key_facts.excerpt: Their boards and advisers are hammering out the terms of the tie-up and governance structure... including how to ring-fence Tesla's operations in China

key_facts.fact: The Verge put the estimated value of the tie-up at $3.5 trillion.
key_facts.excerpt: Bloomberg reports that the estimated $3.5 trillion tie-up could come as soon as December, but could also slip to early 2027

key_facts.fact: Tesla shares rose as much as 1.9% to $398.35 on the report, while SpaceX gained 0.6%.
key_facts.excerpt: Tesla shares rose as much as 1.9% to $398.35 after the report, while SpaceX gained 0.6% to $140.63.

key_facts.fact: A deal would need approval from 50% of all Tesla shareholders; Tesla's annual meeting on Dec. 3 has no merger proposal on the ballot.
key_facts.excerpt: Tesla would need approval from 50 percent of all outstanding shares... That ballot has only three items... and includes no merger proposal.

key_facts.fact: Democrats, who take control of Congress in January after the midterms, have vowed to scrutinize Musk's business and political activities.
